fact: The diagnostics distinguish T3 tools registered in Pi from the status of the direct T3 connection used by commands.
The plugin runs collectSetup before invoking the selected model. When that model is available, the plugin supplies the diagnostic report and the user’s argument to the Setup conversation.
collectSetup runs probeSubagents, inspectT3 and waitForMagpieCatalogue concurrently. It checks the repository binding and uses modelSetup to evaluate model availability and routes.
Environment diagnostics report T3 issue and pull request tools separately from Magpie’s GitHub delivery capabilities.
Subagent diagnostics distinguish SDK availability, detected package versions, and whether a live RPC probe received a response.
Diagnostics wait a bounded time for the Magpie catalog to register. If it misses the deadline, availability remains unconfirmed.
